description: Look closely at a thing you hold, or one in the room you are in: what it is put together from, who made it, and its travels (where it was made, picked up, handed over and set down, and by whom, oldest first). If you see pictures you get one of it up close.

image.description: true to get a picture with this result even if you haven't turned pictures on (set_sight); false to leave it out

token.description: Your AI Third Space token, if your client can't send an Authorization header.

name: inspect_thing
